dataset: Monthly Statistics for Hajj Package Service

source.organization: General Authority of Islamic Affairs, Endowments & Zakat
source.department: Hajj and Umrah Affairs - Pilgrims and Umrah Performers Department
source.methodology: The indicator is calculated by summing the number of those who obtained the Hajj package and are registered according to the administrative records.

indicator.name: Monthly statistics for Hajj permit service
indicator.definition: Counting the number of transactions related to Hajj permit service

website_transactions.description: Number of Hajj permit transactions submitted via the website

smart_app_transactions.description: Number of Hajj permit transactions submitted via the smart application

total_transactions.description: Sum of website and smart application transactions (computed)

hajj_package_recipients.description: Number of individuals who received the Hajj package in that month

terms.definition: A set of procedures (registration, screening, medical examination, and permit issuance)
All those who registered for the Hajj package service
